questions.question: A certain beverage maker's new product became a big topic in society, and people who "want to buy" the stock, expecting future growth, surged. But at the same time, among investors already holding that stock, people who "want to sell" to lock in profit now also surged. Which of the following best explains the stock price movement in this situation?

options.text: Since expectations for the new product are rising, no matter how much sellers increase, the stock price keeps rising without exception
Since both the buying side and the selling side are increasing, the direction of the stock price is decided by the final balance of demand and supply
The moment sellers appear in the market, expectations for the company are deemed completely lost, and the stock price falls in any situation
Whether the company's product was a hit has no relation at all to the increase or decrease in buyers or sellers in the market

answer.text: Since both the buying side and the selling side are increasing, the direction of the stock price is decided by the final balance of demand and supply

questions.question: A certain company's service became a big topic on social media and drew attention as "likely to become popular from here." But looking at the actual revenue and profit data the company announces, no large growth is seen for now. Which of the following is the most appropriate perspective when considering whether to buy this company's stock?

options.text: Since it's a big topic on social media, even if current revenue and profit aren't growing, asserting that the company's growth is already certain
Since actual revenue and profit aren't growing yet, deeming that no matter how much of a topic it is in society, its stock price will absolutely never move
Evaluating the buzz as material that raises expectation (demand), while also confirming the announced performance (reality) like revenue and profit
Judging solely by the size of the buzz—how many people are excited on social media—rather than the performance numbers the company announces

answer.text: Evaluating the buzz as material that raises expectation (demand), while also confirming the announced performance (reality) like revenue and profit

questions.question: Despite no big change in a certain company's revenue or profit, that company's stock price rose. Which of the following is an appropriate factor that pushed up the stock price at this time?

options.text: Expectations for the whole industry the company belongs to rose, and people wanting to buy that industry's stock increased
The price of the company's products or services rose, and the stock price was automatically pulled up in line with the product's price
The company newly issued additional stock, doubling the total number of shares traded in the market from before
The company officially decided and announced a new stock price, rewriting the price displayed in the market's trading system upward

answer.text: Expectations for the whole industry the company belongs to rose, and people wanting to buy that industry's stock increased

questions.question: A certain logistics company's revenue and profit both grew 25% or more over the previous year in this term's earnings, and based on that solid track record, its stock price also rose steadily. Meanwhile, a certain apparel company's revenue and profit this term were roughly unchanged from the previous year, yet triggered by a social media topic, expectation alone ran ahead and its stock price rose sharply. Which of the following is the most accurate view of how the stock prices of these two companies rose?

options.text: Since the logistics company's stock price is rising along with performance growth, expectations beyond reality swell easily, so it has a higher crash risk than the apparel company
Since the apparel company has overwhelming buzz from social media, even with no change in actual performance, the danger of a future stock price crash is extremely low
Since both companies' stock prices are rising the same way, the size of future crash risk is decided not by the current difference in how they rose but solely by the future course of performance
Since the apparel company's stock price is surging on expectation alone without performance backing, it warrants caution as having a very high risk of a sudden crash compared to the logistics company

answer.text: Since the apparel company's stock price is surging on expectation alone without performance backing, it warrants caution as having a very high risk of a sudden crash compared to the logistics company

questions.question: A certain company you're paying attention to keeps growing its revenue and profit powerfully and steadily. However, because the economy of the whole world worsened sharply, the whole stock market's prices crashed, and caught up in it, this company's stock price also fell greatly. Which of the following is an appropriate judgment to make in this scene?

options.text: Since the stock price fell no matter how good the numbers on hand are, suspecting the company must have a fatal flaw you don't know about, and, driven by fear, dumping all the stock on hand
Since the company's performance (substance) is strong but the stock price is falling caught up in the whole market's recession, confirming and judging by separating performance and outside factors

Assuming that when the whole market's economy is bad, even a company with the best performance will definitely fall into the red in the future, and completely giving up on the act of stock investment itself

Since a good, excellent company's stock price falling is a violation of market rules, patiently waiting for the state or government to intervene and forcibly return the stock price to its former high level

answer.text: Since the company's performance (substance) is strong but the stock price is falling caught up in the whole market's recession, confirming and judging by separating performance and outside factors

lessons.unit: Basics of Investing and Wealth Management

questions.question: Which of the following statements about the role of a stock exchange is INCORRECT?

options.text: Gathering the orders of people who "want to buy" and "want to sell" stock in one place, and smoothly establishing buy-sell transactions
Fixing the market's stock price at a constant price at all times and protecting it, so investors who bought stock don't take a loss from a price drop
Establishing a transaction when the conditions (price and quantity) of submitted orders match, and deciding a fair stock price on the spot
Setting common rules on buying and selling and maintaining market order, so anyone can trade with peace of mind without being deceived

answer.text: Fixing the market's stock price at a constant price at all times and protecting it, so investors who bought stock don't take a loss from a price drop

questions.question: The manager of a certain unlisted company wanted to open the company's stock to the market so that investors nationwide could freely buy and sell it. Which of the following is an appropriate condition needed for this company to start trading in the stock market?

options.text: Going directly to the stock exchange's counter and conveying the wish to sell stock to the general public
Putting effort into product and service advertising to raise name recognition, and widely raising public awareness and popularity
Clearing the strict examination standards set by the stock exchange and achieving "listing (IPO)," opening the stock to the market
Gathering, in advance and on your own, an online community of investors (a fan club) who want to buy the company's stock

answer.text: Clearing the strict examination standards set by the stock exchange and achieving "listing (IPO)," opening the stock to the market

questions.question: When you want to grasp, all together without examining companies one by one, the whole stock market's economic wave and price-movement trend, what's used is the "stock index." Which of the following is an appropriate description of this stock index's mechanism and nature?

options.text: Extracting only the stock price of one specific company representing the market, and substituting that company's stock price as the whole market's number as is
A simple sum of the stock prices of all companies existing in the market, accurately reflecting even what each company's stock price is
A sum of all companies' revenue and profit (performance data), completely uncorrelated with the daily actual stock price movements
Aggregating and averaging, by a unique calculation method, the stock prices of multiple companies representing the market, becoming a guide for the whole market's trend

answer.text: Aggregating and averaging, by a unique calculation method, the stock prices of multiple companies representing the market, becoming a guide for the whole market's trend

questions.question: A certain food company wanted to raise large-scale funds to newly build a frozen-food production factory. So it did the necessary procedures and achieved listing (IPO) on the stock exchange. Which of the following is an appropriate effect accompanying this listing, or rule of the stock market?

options.text: The stock exchange becomes that company's supporter and directly grants the company the costs needed for factory construction
Through the stock market, it becomes easier to directly gather, from many investors, the funds needed for the company's growth
The money gathered from investors (the investment funds) must, like a loan from a bank, be fully repaid by a predetermined due date
By passing a strict examination and coming out to the market, the company's value is completely guaranteed, and from now on the stock price will never fall at all

answer.text: Through the stock market, it becomes easier to directly gather, from many investors, the funds needed for the company's growth

questions.question: Suppose a process where a certain venture company makes use of the stock market to greatly expand its business, and eventually develops into a major company representing Egypt. Which of the following is an appropriate description of the stock market's mechanism and role in this whole flow?

options.text: By clearing a strict examination and listing (IPO) on the stock exchange, it becomes able to widely gather growth funds with no repayment needed, and if it grows further to a market-representative scale, it can be incorporated into part of the stock index

Since any company can freely put its own stock up for sale, it does an IPO (initial public offering) without prior examination, and is immediately and automatically registered into the stock index representing the market

Since a stock exchange is a place that prevents stock price falls so investors absolutely never lose, a number summing all the revenue and profit of a once-listed company is announced as a safe stock index

When a company does an IPO, the stock price becomes freely decidable by the company itself, which can rewrite the stock exchange's system, and each time it's a topic in society the stock index is automatically raised

answer.text: By clearing a strict examination and listing (IPO) on the stock exchange, it becomes able to widely gather growth funds with no repayment needed, and if it grows further to a market-representative scale, it can be incorporated into part of the stock index

questions.question:
A and B each think, using the same amount of money, "I'm doing diversification." Which of the following is an appropriate point about these two people's investment situations?
A: Holds stock of companies in three countries—Egypt, America, Japan—divided up.
B: Only Egyptian companies, but holds divided into three kinds—stock, bonds, real estate.

options.text: Since B has only divided asset classes, of the two, only A is diversifying
Since A has only divided countries (regions), of the two, only B is diversifying
A has divided only regions, and B only asset classes, so neither is sufficiently diversified overall
Since both have each divided into multiple things, neither way of dividing has an overlooked axis

answer.text: A has divided only regions, and B only asset classes, so neither is sufficiently diversified overall

questions.question: There's a person continuing installment investing. One month, seeing the stock price drop greatly, they're wavering: "Should I stop buying while it's down, and resume installments after the price recovers?" In light of the purpose of installment investing, which of the following is appropriate advice for this person?

options.text: Stopping buying now while it's down, and resuming installments after the price recovers, avoids taking a loss
Since now that it's dropped is a period when you can buy a large quantity with the same amount, continuing as usual fits the way of thinking of installments
Since the drop is a big chance, stopping installments and investing the full amount on hand all at once is better
While the price is down, pausing installments and buying back in a lump after confirming it's started to rise is better

answer.text: Since now that it's dropped is a period when you can buy a large quantity with the same amount, continuing as usual fits the way of thinking of installments

questions.question:
An investor is wavering over whether to make their portfolio's ratio "Plan A" or "Plan B." Which of the following correctly explains the difference between these two plans?
Plan A: stock 90%, bonds 10%
Plan B: stock 50%, bonds 50%

options.text: Since Plan A has a high ratio of stock with somewhat large price movement, it's a build where the whole investment's price movement tends to be large
Since Plan A and Plan B both total the same 100%, it's a build where the size of the portfolio's price movement is unchanged either way
Since Plan B divides in halves, it's a build that holds down risk more than Plan A while its return becomes larger than Plan A
Since Plan A has a high ratio of stock, it's a build where risk becomes larger than Plan B, but return also definitely becomes larger

answer.text: Since Plan A has a high ratio of stock with somewhat large price movement, it's a build where the whole investment's price movement tends to be large

questions.question: You were approached in a certain investment solicitation with the following talk: "This product reliably gets you a high return every month, and moreover the principal (the money you invested) absolutely never decreases." In light of the "relationship between risk and return" you've learned, which of the following is the most appropriate judgment about this solicitation?

options.text: If the person who introduced it is trustworthy, you may take up the talk even if the relationship between risk and return doesn't fit
If you start with a small amount and watch, you can safely try even a talk that doesn't fit the relationship between risk and return
Since it's an impossible talk departing from the investment basic that risk and return are proportional, firmly decline it
Since it's a mechanism where return comes in every month, you don't have to mind the relationship between risk and return

answer.text: Since it's an impossible talk departing from the investment basic that risk and return are proportional, firmly decline it

questions.question: A person about to start investing says the following: "I have the feeling of wanting to continue long, but if the money I invested drops greatly in value, I'll get worried and unsettled, and seem likely to let go of it right away." Which of the following is the most appropriate way to build a portfolio suited to this person's risk tolerance?

options.text: If you intend to continue long, you can recover over time, so make a build that boldly raises the ratio of stock
So risk doesn't bias, make a build with stock, bonds, and gold each at the same ratio
Make a build with more of something with gentle price movement like bonds, and stock modest
Directly imitate the same ratio as a person who says their investment is going well

answer.text: Make a build with more of something with gentle price movement like bonds, and stock modest

lessons.unit: Basics of Investing and Wealth Management

questions.question:
Based on the information of the following two companies, which of the following best explains their overall value (market capitalization) and whether they are a good deal?
Company X: stock price 80 EGP, number of issued shares 1 billion
Company Y: stock price 1,200 EGP, number of issued shares 5 million

options.text: You can judge that Company Y, with the higher stock price per share, is also the company with larger market capitalization
Since the stock price per share is lower, you can judge that Company X is cheaper
Market capitalization is larger for Company X, but whether it's cheap can't be decided until you compare the substance
Since the market capitalization is larger, you can judge that Company X is cheaper

answer.text: Market capitalization is larger for Company X, but whether it's cheap can't be decided until you compare the substance

questions.question: An investor learns that Company A's PER is 10 times and the average PER of the same industry as Company A is 15 times, and says, "Since it's lower than the industry average, this company is cheap. Let's buy right away." Which of the following is an appropriate point about this investor's way of thinking?

options.text: Since the PER is lower than the industry average, Company A is cheap, and buying without additional confirmation is good

Since the PER is lower than the industry average, Company A can be considered to have a tendency to be cheap. However, judge the investment after also confirming the reason and the company's situation
Since the PER is lower than the industry average, you can judge Company A is a company with a bad management condition
Since PER is an indicator that can't be used for comparison, even if it's lower than the industry average, it's no clue to whether it's cheap

answer.text: Since the PER is lower than the industry average, Company A can be considered to have a tendency to be cheap. However, judge the investment after also confirming the reason and the company's situation

questions.question: Company A's PBR was 0.7 times, and Company B's PBR was 2.5 times. Which of the following best explains the status of these two companies based on their PBR values?

options.text: Company A's PBR of 0.7 times means the stock price is at a level of 0.7 times earnings per share
Company A's stock price is priced cheaper than net assets, and Company B's higher than net assets, but investment judgment can't be decided by height alone
Since Company A is below 1 time and Company B above 1 time, you can definitively judge A as cheap and B as expensive
You can read that Company B, with the higher PBR, is a company with a better management condition than Company A

answer.text: Company A's stock price is priced cheaper than net assets, and Company B's higher than net assets, but investment judgment can't be decided by height alone

questions.question:
Compare Company A and Company B in the same industry. From the viewpoint of ROE (return on equity), which of the following is an appropriate explanation of these two companies?
Company A: shareholders' equity 1 million EGP, one year's net profit 200,000 EGP
Company B: shareholders' equity 5 million EGP, one year's net profit 500,000 EGP

options.text: Since the amount of net profit is larger for Company B, you can judge Company B earns more efficiently
Since ROE is a number calculated using the stock price, ROE can't be found from this information alone
Earning efficiency (ROE) is higher for Company A, and it needs to be seen separately from the size of the net profit amount
Company B, with larger shareholders' equity as seed money, also has higher ROE

answer.text: Earning efficiency (ROE) is higher for Company A, and it needs to be seen separately from the size of the net profit amount

questions.question: A certain company's PER, PBR, and ROE were all favorable numbers compared to the industry average. Meanwhile, the president recently changed, and the new management team's track record is still unknown. Which of the following is an appropriate investment judgment for this company?

options.text: Since the three numbers are more favorable than the industry average, buying right away as is is correct
Judging while watching the new management team's state, including the part that doesn't appear in numbers
A company whose president changed is better avoided, regardless of the three numbers
Since the manager doesn't matter as long as the numbers are good, you may ignore the information of the president change

answer.text: Judging while watching the new management team's state, including the part that doesn't appear in numbers

questions.question:
The following two investors are each about to buy stock of a different company. Which of the following is an appropriate explanation of these two people's investment styles?
P: "This company's current PER is considerably lower than the industry average. The business is stable and trustworthy, yet the stock price looks like it hasn't caught up with the real strength, so I'm thinking of buying."
Q: "This company's current PER is on the high side, but it's grown rapidly recently, so I see the profit increasing several-fold from here. So, anticipating the future, I'm thinking of buying now."

options.text: P corresponds to value investing focusing on current cheapness, and Q to growth investing focusing on future growth
P corresponds to growth investing focusing on future growth, and Q to value investing focusing on current cheapness
Since both use the current PER as a clue, both correspond to value investing
Since both are trying to buy thinking of "the future," both correspond to growth investing

answer.text: P corresponds to value investing focusing on current cheapness, and Q to growth investing focusing on future growth

questions.question: Suppose there's an investment trust where 100 people each put out 100 EGP. The gathered money is invested by a management specialist divided into stock and bonds. Which of the following is an appropriate explanation of "each individual's investment situation" at this time?

options.text: Since the funds one person put out are only 100 EGP, as that person's own investment, it doesn't become a diversified form at all.
Since a specialist invests the 10,000 EGP where everyone's money gathered divided up, even at 100 EGP per person, you can hold a powerful diversification form.
Since a management specialist manages it on your behalf, no fee arises along the way, and it reliably grows with no worry of the principal decreasing.
The more people participating in the investment trust and putting out money, the larger the ratio of profit (share) each investor gets automatically becomes.

answer.text: Since a specialist invests the 10,000 EGP where everyone's money gathered divided up, even at 100 EGP per person, you can hold a powerful diversification form.

questions.question: A person thinks, "I want to buy and sell at my own timing, while watching the price of the moment, during the hours the market is open." Which of the following correctly matches a product that fits this wish with its corresponding reason?

options.text: An ETF is appropriate, because, like stock in the stock market, it can be bought and sold at the real-time price of the moment while the market is open
An investment trust is appropriate, because it has a mechanism where the price is decided once a day, so you can buy and sell each time at your favorite timing during the day.
Either one you choose is the same, because an investment trust and an ETF completely share both the way of thinking about the pack contents and the concrete rules of how to buy in the market.
An ETF is appropriate, because, unlike an investment trust, it's a product containing just one company's stock alone, so it can be bought and sold on the spot exactly like ordinary stock.

answer.text: An ETF is appropriate, because, like stock in the stock market, it can be bought and sold at the real-time price of the moment while the market is open

questions.question: A person thinks, "Index investing diversifies across the whole market, so the price never drops." Which of the following is an appropriate evaluation of this thought?

options.text: This thought is correct, and since it invests widely diversified across the whole market, even if there's a company whose stock price drops, the whole price never drops.
This thought is wrong, and since it's a mechanism linking entirely to the whole market's movement, in periods when the whole market slumps, the product drops in value together.
This thought is wrong, but by the effect of dividing widely across the whole market, even when the whole market drops, it's almost unaffected.
This thought is wrong, and since it's fundamentally a short-term trading method of selling out before the price drops, if you match the timing, you won't take a loss.

answer.text: This thought is wrong, and since it's a mechanism linking entirely to the whole market's movement, in periods when the whole market slumps, the product drops in value together.

questions.question: A person accumulates an index-linked investment trust containing companies of multiple regions, at a fixed amount each month. Which of the following is the most appropriate way of thinking about the "diversification across time" contained in this way of buying?

options.text: The way of thinking that predicting the day the price becomes cheap and buying in a lump that day tends to lower the buying price
The way of thinking that diversification across time refers not to the buying period, but to how long you keep holding after buying
The way of thinking of dividing the buying period into multiple times, making the buying price less swayed by the high or low of a specific day
The way of thinking that increasing or decreasing the monthly amount in line with the price, and aligning the quantity bought instead, makes diversification across time work better

answer.text: The way of thinking of dividing the buying period into multiple times, making the buying price less swayed by the high or low of a specific day

questions.question:
A person about to start investing says the following. Which of the following is the most appropriate combination of methods fitting this person's wish?
"I don't have that much money, so I'm thinking of starting with a small amount. I have the feeling of continuing long, but I can't take much time to research companies one by one, so I want to use something divided up from the start as much as possible."

options.text: Buying more of a product linked to multiple stock indices like domestic, US, and Europe, only in months when a lump of funds is available
Choosing one product linked to multiple regions' stock indices, and keep buying at the same amount each month
Choosing one product combining multiple asset classes with different price movements like stock, bonds, and real estate, and buying more only in months it rose in price
Choosing one product combining about 10 domestic individual companies, and keep buying at the same amount each month

answer.text: Choosing one product linked to multiple regions' stock indices, and keep buying at the same amount each month

questions.question: A certain shopping app displays "this product is recommended too" to users. Which of the following best explains this AI's function?

options.text: AI finds tendencies from the user's past behavior data and predicts products they're likely to take an interest in next
AI reads the user's conversation content, understands the true feelings the person hasn't put into words, and chooses products
AI is only classifying products by type, so the recommended products displayed don't change by user
AI looks only at products' sales data and displays the best-selling product the same way to all users

answer.text: AI finds tendencies from the user's past behavior data and predicts products they're likely to take an interest in next

questions.question: A certain high school student is thinking of consulting a chat AI service about "a fight with a friend." Which of the following is the most appropriate way to use the service in this situation?

options.text: To convey the consultation content accurately, inputting the other person's name and school name in as much detail as possible
Not inputting information that identifies the other person, and generalizing the content if needed before consulting
Since AI's answers are always correct with no mistakes, sending the returned apology text to the other person as is without checking the content
Thinking it's safe if you "delete the history" from the phone screen, and consulting with the name entered as is

answer.text: Not inputting information that identifies the other person, and generalizing the content if needed before consulting

questions.question: A certain company is about to use a generative AI chat service, which is also popular on social media, for its work. Which of the following is the most appropriate way to use it?

options.text: Since text made by generative AI has proper grammar, publishing it as is without checking the content
To reduce work time, having it read and summarize materials containing customer names and contact details as is
Having it make a draft of a product description, and using it after the person in charge confirms it matches the facts
Since it's a service for general users rather than for companies, it's better not to use it for creating the company's product descriptions or ad proposals

answer.text: Having it make a draft of a product description, and using it after the person in charge confirms it matches the facts

questions.question: A certain company is about to introduce AI into its operations to advance efficiency. Which of the following is NOT an efficiency gain that can be expected from using AI?

options.text: Having AI estimate next month's demand from past sales, reducing over- and under-purchasing
Leaving the draft of product descriptions to AI, reducing the effort for the person in charge to compose text
Leaving small talk and relationship-building among staff to AI, improving the atmosphere and reducing mistakes
Having AI automatically route large volumes of inquiry emails by content, reducing the sorting work

answer.text: Leaving small talk and relationship-building among staff to AI, improving the atmosphere and reducing mistakes

questions.question: A certain supermarket used AI that predicts sales from past sales data, making use of it for daily purchasing. However, when a new station was built nearby and the customer base changed completely, AI's predictions started missing more often. Which of the following correctly pairs a likely reason for this with a solution to it?

options.text: Since customers increased and calculations became complex, replacing it with AI of higher processing capability
Having AI read nationwide popular-product information every month, and learning the trend of revenue
Since AI hasn't learned how things sell after the customer base changed, having it relearn with new data
Having AI relearn using a lot of data over a longer period, going further back into the past

answer.text: Since AI hasn't learned how things sell after the customer base changed, having it relearn with new data

questions.question:
Which of the following correctly identifies the services and cases where fintech technology is used, from ( 1 )-( 4 ) below?
( 1 ) A household account app that links with bank accounts and credit cards and automatically calculates income and expenses
( 2 ) A service that uses a smartphone app to reserve a seat at a popular restaurant
( 3 ) A service where AI automatically manages investment matched to that person's target amount
( 4 ) A procedure of lining up at a bank counter and making a transfer with a handwritten form and cash
Regarding the payment method called "BNPL," often used in online shopping lately, which of the following best explains its features and points to note?

options.text: It has the convenience of receiving the product first, and the more you pay in installments, the smaller the total amount becomes
It has the ease of being usable even without a credit card, and no additional cost occurs at all even if payment is late
It has the convenience of making it easier to buy what you want right away, and once you register, you can keep using it without minding the payment amount
It has the convenience of getting the product first, but since payment occurs later, planned confirmation is needed

answer.text: It has the convenience of getting the product first, but since payment occurs later, planned confirmation is needed

questions.question: A certain company provides a pay-later payment service usable in online shopping. When an application saying "I want to use this service" arrives from a user, which of the following best describes the role of the "credit scoring" this company performs?

options.text: Confirming on the spot whether the applicant is the person themselves, preventing impersonation
Increasing as much as possible the payment methods users can choose, making it easier to apply
Scoring creditworthiness based on usage data at other financial services and such, and judging whether they seem able to pay on time
Sending a notice to users whose payment deadline is approaching, so they don't forget to pay

answer.text: Scoring creditworthiness based on usage data at other financial services and such, and judging whether they seem able to pay on time

questions.question: There's a person thinking of starting to invest little by little for the future. They decided to use a robo-advisor on a smartphone app, which proposes an investment plan suited to them when they answer questions about age, goals, and how much risk they can take. Which of the following is the most appropriate mindset when using this service?

options.text: Understanding the risk of price drops, referring to the proposals, and ultimately judging and using it themselves
Since AI chooses safe investment targets, using it thinking that if they leave everything to the proposals, they absolutely won't lose
Since the proposed plan has its profit protected by law, using it thinking there's no worry of price drops
Using it thinking that even if a loss occurs from a price drop, the app's company will compensate the full amount afterward

answer.text: Understanding the risk of price drops, referring to the proposals, and ultimately judging and using it themselves

questions.question: At a certain bank where many transfers and withdrawals happen daily, they decided to introduce AI to prevent the crime of using other people's accounts without permission. Which of the following is the most appropriate way to use AI-based fraud detection at this bank?

options.text: Transactions AI judged fraudulent are handled as is without canceling the judgment, even if the person reports "I made that transaction myself"
AI finds suspicious transactions differing from usual, and it's used as a clue for a person to confirm whether it's really fraud
Since AI is always monitoring, trusting that misuse can be prevented even if you tell your password to someone else
Having AI monitor only nighttime and holiday transactions, while people manually check everything on weekday afternoons

answer.text: AI finds suspicious transactions differing from usual, and it's used as a clue for a person to confirm whether it's really fraud

questions.question:
There are two AI products for shops, developed based on the same foundation model (a text-generation AI). Their features are as follows.
Product A: A dedicated design that reduces the response time for restaurant reservations and inquiries. Based on the shop's basic information, AI creates a draft answer, and the owner confirms and corrects it on screen before sending it to the customer.
Product B: A general-purpose design able to handle questions from any industry. A configuration usable as is, without the effort of initial setup, as a chat window easily introduced onto a shop's website.
Which of the following correctly pairs the product chosen by many restaurants worried about the risk of wrong answers with the reason?

options.text: Product A: because it focuses on users' concrete problems and designs an operation screen and peripheral systems that make it easy for humans to confirm and correct
Product B: because it has a general-purpose design able to handle questions from any industry, and a configuration usable as is without the effort of initial setup
Product A: because AI automatically creates drafts from the shop's basic information, so it can be sent to customers with the effort of on-screen confirmation and correction removed entirely
Product B: because making it a general-purpose system not limited to a specific industry raises the text-generation processing performance of the linked foundation model itself

answer.text: Product A: because it focuses on users' concrete problems and designs an operation screen and peripheral systems that make it easy for humans to confirm and correct

questions.question: A certain company is considering the following four scenes, from developing a new product to putting it on sale. Which of these scenes is NOT suited to using AI?

options.text: The scene of estimating how much each product is likely to sell next month, from data like past sales records and weather
The scene of automatically sorting the free-text responses of many customer surveys by content, grasping the tendency of common opinions
The scene of having many catchphrase proposals put out for product promotion, broadening the range of ideas
The scene of making the final decision, based on the assembled information, on whether the company will put this product on sale

answer.text: The scene of making the final decision, based on the assembled information, on whether the company will put this product on sale

questions.question: There's an AI startup planning a service for shops, linked with one foundation model (an externally provided AI service) provided by another company. However, just before development, a sudden announcement was made of a price increase and rule changes for the foundation model they planned to use. Which of the following is the most appropriate action for this company to consider and take at this point?

options.text: Forcing development through as originally planned, and after releasing the service, attempting to negotiate with the giant IT company providing it to return to the original fees and rules

Re-verifying whether the business holds up under the announced new conditions, and revising the plan toward a program design that makes it easy to switch to a different foundation model, so as not to depend on a specific external AI service, then proceeding with development

To completely eliminate the risk of another company's rule changes, canceling all plans to link with external AI services, and changing to a plan of developing an equivalent foundation model in house from scratch at enormous cost

Assuming this change is a special case, merely changing the linked provider to another world-famous major foundation model, and proceeding with development as originally planned without considering future ease of switching

answer.text: Re-verifying whether the business holds up under the announced new conditions, and revising the plan toward a program design that makes it easy to switch to a different foundation model, so as not to depend on a specific external AI service, then proceeding with development

questions.question: At a certain AI image-generation service, every time a user creates an image, server maintenance and calculation processing costs (expenses) occur behind the scenes. Which of the following best explains how to design a revenue model (pricing plan) considering this AI service's cost structure?

options.text: Monthly subscription model: since monthly revenue is stable at a fixed amount no matter how many images users create, it can avoid the risk of behind-the-scenes costs increasing with usage volume.

Usage-based pricing model (pay-as-you-go): since the fee varies according to the number of images generated, it's easier to keep the balance between revenue and a cost structure where behind-the-scenes costs increase in proportion to usage volume.
Freemium model: if basic functions are provided free, behind-the-scenes costs can be held low no matter how many images users generate in bulk, so losses are easier to prevent.

Enterprise contract model: since fees are estimated individually per company and fixed at a flat rate, behind-the-scenes costs can be held within a certain range no matter how many images are created in bulk, making it easier to achieve profitability.

answer.text: Usage-based pricing model (pay-as-you-go): since the fee varies according to the number of images generated, it's easier to keep the balance between revenue and a cost structure where behind-the-scenes costs increase in proportion to usage volume.

questions.question:
You're planning and developing a "shop support AI app," linked with the same external foundation model (a text-generation AI service), where small local shops can easily create promotional text on a smartphone. Which of the following sets of words best fills in the blanks ( 1 )-( 4 ) in the following text, which correctly explains "money management (costs and risks)" and "handling of data" in operating this app?
"Since behind-the-scenes costs increase the more users use the app, devise the ( 1 ) so the company doesn't run a deficit. Also, in preparation for future terms changes, make a design that makes it easy to switch to ( 2 ). Furthermore, it's important to prevent ( 3 ) of shops' data, and to explain clearly to users the ( 4 ) of using the data."

options.text: ( 1 ) pricing plan ( 2 ) a different AI ( 3 ) leakage ( 4 ) purpose
( 1 ) pricing plan ( 2 ) in-house AI ( 3 ) sharing ( 4 ) change
( 1 ) screen design ( 2 ) a different AI ( 3 ) sharing ( 4 ) change
( 1 ) screen design ( 2 ) in-house AI ( 3 ) leakage ( 4 ) purpose

answer.text: ( 1 ) pricing plan ( 2 ) a different AI ( 3 ) leakage ( 4 ) purpose

questions.question: Which of the following best represents "routine work" that is easily delegated to AI?

options.text: At a cafe selling coffee, the work of selling while making thoughtful small talk suited to each customer, and deciding the shop's management policy
In police box duty, the work of rushing to the scene on receiving a report, apprehending suspicious persons, and listening closely to victims
At a toy manufacturing company, the work of aggregating the collected internal survey response data, making graphs and tables, and compiling them into reporting materials
In an advertising agency's sales department, the work of having a new junior colleague accompany you on client visits and teaching them the knack of sales

answer.text: At a toy manufacturing company, the work of aggregating the collected internal survey response data, making graphs and tables, and compiling them into reporting materials

questions.question: At a certain call center, an AI chatbot that automatically answers simple inquiries was introduced. Among the inquiries human operators used to handle, AI came to handle "frequently asked questions." Which of the following best explains the relationship between this "automation of part of the work" and the risk of "job displacement"?

options.text: Since an AI chatbot was introduced into part of the inquiry response, you can say job displacement occurred in the very job type of operator that humans used to handle
Even if responding to "frequently asked questions" is automated, humans become able to concentrate on other, more complex inquiry responses, so "job displacement" doesn't occur immediately
To minimize the risk of "job displacement," you can say that completely separating the division of roles between AI and people for phone response and email response is the only method
Even if AI is introduced, humans and AI end up dividing exactly the same work and continue responding to "frequently asked questions," so you can say job displacement doesn't occur

answer.text: Even if responding to "frequently asked questions" is automated, humans become able to concentrate on other, more complex inquiry responses, so "job displacement" doesn't occur immediately

questions.question: Which of the following does NOT count as a case of AI use?

options.text: At a software development company, the work of summarizing proceedings and creating materials based on meeting notes
At a bank, the work of quickly finding unnatural transactions suspected of fraud from past transaction records
At a food development company, the work of classifying survey responses about a new product by similar opinions
At a school, the work of a career guidance teacher giving consultations while considering each student's feelings and circumstances

answer.text: At a school, the work of a career guidance teacher giving consultations while considering each student's feelings and circumstances

questions.question: A certain person is about to open "a shop that provides drinks perfectly matched to each customer's request." Which of the following is NOT an appropriate way to use AI at this shop?

options.text: Leaving all customer service and drink provision to AI, and having humans leave the shop unstaffed to go buy ingredients
When planning a new menu, having AI put out ideas suited to the customer base, and humans thinking with that as reference
Having AI draft the text posted on the shop's social media, and humans adjusting it to match the purpose of the message
Having AI organize and analyze past order data, and using it as reference when deciding next week's purchase volume

answer.text: Leaving all customer service and drink provision to AI, and having humans leave the shop unstaffed to go buy ingredients

questions.question: A certain company uses AI in document screening for new employees. It has AI learn past hiring data and screening rules and uses them as material for judgment. Which of the following is the most appropriate point to keep in mind in this situation?

options.text: Since AI is good at information analysis, screening should be left entirely to AI, and humans should concentrate only on notifying the results
If the past records AI learns have a leaning, an unfair leaning may appear in the screening results too
The stronger the specific tendencies contained in past hiring data, the higher AI's screening accuracy becomes
Large-scale information processing is AI's strong field, and the reliability of results rises in proportion to the amount of data it learns

answer.text: If the past records AI learns have a leaning, an unfair leaning may appear in the screening results too

questions.question: Which of the following best explains "AI literacy"?

options.text: A skill that becomes necessary in using AI, whose level rises in proportion to how much you use AI
Humans' mental attitude toward AI, and a condition that must always be met when newly developing AI
Skills and a stance for getting along safely and well with AI, and the ability to master it proactively without taking information at face value
Something for living so as to be as uninvolved with AI as possible, such as the ability to "distinguish" what AI created

answer.text: Skills and a stance for getting along safely and well with AI, and the ability to master it proactively without taking information at face value

questions.question:
You saw a post on social media saying "a certain famous athlete is raving about a new health food." Which of the following correctly identifies the actions for confirming whether this information is real, from the viewpoint of "confirming whether there's backing" (a cross-check)?
( 1 ) Checking whether the official site of the team that athlete belongs to has an announcement about a connection with the health food
( 2 ) Checking the post's view count and number of "likes," and judging it real if many people have seen it
( 3 ) Investigating whether the same information is reported in articles from major news media, newspapers, and magazines
( 4 ) Searching for posts with the same wording on other social media too, and judging it real if multiple people say the same thing

The following text is an explanation of "data privacy." Which of the following pairs of words best fills in the blanks ( 1 ) and ( 2 )?
"Data privacy is ( 2 ) about how your personal information is used, ( 1 )."

options.text: ( 1 ) when, to whom, and how far you provide it / ( 2 ) the right to manage it worldwide
( 1 ) in what places and for what uses / ( 2 ) the right to manage it worldwide
( 1 ) when, to whom, and how far you provide it / ( 2 ) the right to control yourself
( 1 ) in what places and for what uses / ( 2 ) the right to control yourself

answer.text: ( 1 ) when, to whom, and how far you provide it / ( 2 ) the right to control yourself

questions.question: When inputting information into AI, which of the following does NOT correctly explain how it should be handled?

options.text: The member roster, activity records, and grade information of the club you belong to are fine to input into AI
Friends' addresses and phone numbers are other people's personal information, so you mustn't input them into AI on your own judgment
Your own name, face photos, and such all require stopping and thinking once before inputting them into AI
A list of domestic station names is publicly available information everyone knows, so it's fine to input into AI

answer.text: The member roster, activity records, and grade information of the club you belong to are fine to input into AI

questions.question:
X, a junior high school student, input the following prompt to have AI think of research ideas for a club presentation. However, the ideas that came back from AI mostly required expensive equipment or took several months to complete, and were all hard to actually do in club activities. Which of the following elements should X add to the prompt?
The prompt X input: "You are a veteran science teacher. Please tell me three ideas for interesting experiments as research to do in a junior high school science club. I want to carry it out at a club presentation, so please make them experiments with simple steps and easy-to-understand visual results."

options.text: The premise "as research to do in a junior high school science club"
The conditions "within 500 EGP in cost" and "completed in about one week"
The standpoint "a veteran scientist engaged in world-class research and development"
The condition "not too expensive and in a short time"

answer.text: The conditions "within 500 EGP in cost" and "completed in about one week"

questions.question:
A certain person manages a shop selling health foods. To make daily store operations more efficient and improve the shop, they decided to sort the following daily tasks ( 1 )-( 4 ) into "work to leave to AI" and "work humans should handle." Which of the following correctly identifies each task as "work to leave to AI" or "work humans should handle"?
( 1 ) Purchase prediction: predicting how many of which product will sell next week, based on the shop's past sales data and weather data
( 2 ) Customer service: giving greetings and guidance close to the day's physical condition and mood, from the expressions and conversation of customers who visit
( 3 ) Answering frequently asked questions: automatically replying 24 hours a day to inquiries arriving on the website about "business hours," "access," and such
( 4 ) Handling complaints: accepting the feelings of a customer who came in angry because of a product defect, and apologizing sincerely

A certain international startup decided to develop a food distribution platform as a new service, to reduce "food loss," a problem worldwide. Which of the following correctly identifies the steps, from ( 1 )-( 4 ) below, where using AI is most effective?
( 1 ) Local needs research: going to farms and supermarkets around the world and, through dialogue, drawing out the real "true feelings and troubles" the parties hold about why food ends up thrown away
( 2 ) Data analysis of existing cases: comprehensively comparing and classifying data on the functions and success and failure cases of hundreds of similar services already existing worldwide
( 3 ) Concluding international partnerships: to advance global expansion, directly conveying with passion the future this service aims for to leaders of each country's major distributors and international organizations, and building trust
( 4 ) Creating a prototype application: based on the instructions of a blueprint made by humans, rapidly writing out the basic program code for the service's prototype app to run minimally

A person who worked 15 years as a bookstore clerk, confident in their book knowledge and customer service, is being transferred to "digital marketing manager" along with the company's digitalization. Which of the following is the most appropriate "career strategy" for this person to demonstrate their value in the coming era?

options.text: While using the "book knowledge" and "customer service skills" cultivated so far as a foundation, newly learning "data analysis" and "web customer acquisition" skills to create a strength only they have
Since the digital field is highly specialized, discarding all their bookstore-clerk experience and pouring all their time only into learning IT tools would raise their value the most

Trusting the expertise deepened over 15 years, making use of the acquired "customer service skills" and "book knowledge," and continuing to work in their own way without changing from how they've done it
Since keeping up with the changing times is very hard, learning only when the company prepares training, and not taking on other learning on their own initiative

answer.text: While using the "book knowledge" and "customer service skills" cultivated so far as a foundation, newly learning "data analysis" and "web customer acquisition" skills to create a strength only they have

questions.question: Which of the following is the most appropriate approach to building a "skill portfolio" for someone planning to run an agricultural business in the future, in order to respond to technological innovation and market changes?

options.text: Learning all work in cultivation, finance, and sales evenly, broadly and shallowly, and not holding any specific deeply learned field
So as not to be swayed by changes in the times, learning only a specific cultivation technique as deeply as possible, and not learning any other management skills at all
While polishing deep expertise with cultivation technique as the core, broadly covering the financial and sales knowledge needed for management
Aiming to master cultivation, finance, and sales all to expert level at the same time, raising each expertise simultaneously

answer.text: While polishing deep expertise with cultivation technique as the core, broadly covering the financial and sales knowledge needed for management

questions.question: There's an entrepreneur about to launch their own shop and get its management on track. Which of the following actions correctly combines "financial literacy" and "AI literacy" to proactively control the business while holding down risk?

options.text: Since accurately analyzing customers' purchase data with AI identified products likely to be hits from here, pouring all the shop's funds into purchasing those to maximize revenue

While referring to the next month's revenue data AI predicted, the entrepreneur themselves deciding the final purchase volume within a safe budget range, to avoid the risk of running short of cash on hand
While having AI analyze financial data to hold down management costs, rejecting the "fixed-cost reduction plan" AI proposed in light of hallucination risk, and continuing the conventional way

Making use of AI to improve the shop's income-expense balance, and putting into practice as is the cost-cutting plan AI automatically generated of "abolishing after-sales service to customers to raise the profit margin"

answer.text: While referring to the next month's revenue data AI predicted, the entrepreneur themselves deciding the final purchase volume within a safe budget range, to avoid the risk of running short of cash on hand
